Thanks — quick assessment below. I can approve a conditional invoice-only onboarding for a low-dollar pilot, but need the following evidence before approval (procurement minimums):

1) Completed onboarding form (we have this)
2) W-9 or equivalent tax form
3) SOC 2 Type 2 summary / security questionnaire or attestation (latest 12 months)
4) Bank remittance details and an invoice template showing payment terms (net 30)
5) Commitment that the customer will execute the master services agreement within 60 days or we reserve right to suspend invoice-only privileges

If they provide items 1–4 immediately I will issue a conditional approval (60-day invoice-only pilot cap of $5,000). Please request the docs and ask James to put billing contact in the onboarding form.

I’m attaching a quick onboarding-checklist template so we can track evidence.

Irene
